title: Always a Catch
description: From a very young age, people noticed that Maria, the youngest daughter of a duke, was filled with potential. She was raised as the heiress of her house, until the birth of her baby brother relieves her of her duties. She scrambles to find a husband, but all the eligible bachelors in her duchy are taken! At this rate, she’s doomed to the life of a spinster! Maria decides to study abroad in Rubini in hopes of finding a husband, with the help of her distant relative, Aida. But in a twist of fate, the Crown Prince breaks of his engagement with Maria, even though they’ve never met before! “Huh?! I don’t remember getting engaged!?” Enjoy this fluffy romcom with a late-blooming villainess! Source – Manga Up! Global Always a Catch, Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga, Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken, The Fish I Missed Was Big, but I Caught Another Fish Was Too Big, 逃がした魚は大きかったが 釣り上げた魚が大きすぎた件, 逃がした魚は大きかったが釣りあげた魚が大きすぎた件
